The course also introduces the first three SAP modules, SD (Sales Distribution), MM (Material Management) and PP (Product Planning). sections.heading: Syllabus Details
rows: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study

The course demonstrates concepts, principles, techniques, and applications of ERP systems in general and SAP in particular. The course recalls the components and the structure of an enterprise and introduces the design of SAP that is compatible with this structure. The course also introduces the first three SAP modules, SD (Sales Distribution), MM (Material Management) and PP (Product Planning). Theory, case study, practical sessions and workshop with SAP Experts are arranged alternately, helping students understand the operation of these modules.

- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

sections.heading: 6 LO(s)
rows: Describe the fundamentals of ERP and SAP: their concepts, techniques, navigations and applications.
Describe the integrated order-to-cash cycle (SD), the purchase-to-pay business process (MM) and the Product Planning (PP) modules.
Perform simple operations on SD, MM, PP modules
Analyze business case studies and apply SAP system to handle situations
Evaluate all the tasks performed to solve the case studies
Develop professional working style, good teamwork skills and compliance with the production process.
